description: A directory prefixed with @ (such as @analytics or @modal) that passes its rendered route branch as a prop to the sibling layout.tsx without adding a segment to the URL path.
The standard page.tsx and nested route segments inside a layout directory, which behave identically to a parallel slot named children.
During client-side navigation, if a slot does not have a route matching the new URL, Next.js keeps rendering that slot's previously active view from client state.
On a full-page load or browser refresh, Next.js has no previous slot state in memory and must match either the exact URL route or a default.tsx file in every slot.
A special file inside a slot (or the root of a parallel route segment) that renders on hard navigation when the current URL does not match any explicit route inside that slot.
